events.verdict: Jackson Jr. (MEM) dislodges the ball from George (PHI).
Aldama (MEM) legally contests Edgecombe's (PHI) jump shot attempt.
Bona (PHI) moves slightly toward Jackson Jr.'s (MEM) path and the contact during the drive is marginal.
After initially making contact with the ball, George (PHI) makes contact with Jackson Jr.'s (MEM) arm as he defends the shot attempt.
Wells (MEM) brings his hands towards Maxey (PHI) as he releases away to switch onto Edgecombe (PHI).
Jackson Jr. (MEM) maintains verticality as he defends Edgecombe's (PHI) shot attempt.  Jackson Jr. (MEM) then cleanly blocks the shot attempt.
Embiid (PHI) contests Morant's (MEM) shot attempt and the foot to foot contact that occurs after both players return to the ground is incidental.
Jackson Jr. (MEM) briefly grasps Embiid's (PHI) jersey as they pursue the rebound.  Edgecombe (PHI) then cleanly ties up Jackson Jr. and a jump ball is correctly called.
Maxey (PHI) does not extend his hands into Morant's (MEM) upper body as Morant secures possession.

Replay review of the out of bounds called on Morant (MEM) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Morant is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the 76ers.
Grimes (PHI) and Coward (MEM) briefly engage and disengage as they pursue the rebound.
Edgecombe (PHI) directly contests Wells' (MEM) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Wells' hand after the release.
Maxey (PHI) directly contests Aldama's (MEM) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Aldama's hand after the release.
Jackson Jr. (MEM) moves alongside George's (PHI) path as he defends the shot attempt.
George (PHI) goes to, not through, Jackson Jr.'s (MEM) space as he releases away from the contact.
Maxey (PHI) deflects the ball away from Coward (MEM).
Coward (MEM) loses control of the ball and legally resumes his dribble upon regaining control of the ball.
George (PHI) extends his hand into Morant's (MEM) upper body prior to making any contact with the ball.
Morant (MEM) overtly, and abruptly, raises his arms towards Grimes (PHI) and the contact is marginal.
Morant (MEM) lifts his pivot foot prior to the release of his dribble.
George (PHI) directly contests Morant's (MEM) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Morant's hand after the release.
Embiid (PHI) establishes his left foot as his pivot foot, which he moves after his gather.
Edgecombe (PHI) moves alongside Morant's (MEM) path as he defends the shot attempt.
Morant (MEM) legally contests Edgecombe's (PHI) jump shot attempt.
Aldama (MEM) inbounds the ball within five seconds.
Edgecombe (PHI) legally contests Coward's (MEM) jump shot attempt.
